title: Curated player
description: One row of data/curated/players.jsonl: a player the corpus references, with the handle the source states. Its canonical ID is anchored on the player's wiki page, which survives a handle change (see tools/dataset/identity.ts); the handles and old pages that also denote the player are rows in aliases.jsonl. Two different players may share a handle — measured: eight entities answer to `Wolf` — and they stay two entities, which is why the ID is the page and not the handle.

id.description: Opaque surrogate key derived from the player page (spec D3). Do not parse it: read the row through `name`.

name.description: The player's current handle as the source states it, so the row reads without decoding the ID (spec R12). Not unique: it is a display string.

overviewPage.description: The player's wiki page. Null only when a scoreboard cited a link the source registers no page for: that entity is minted and reported in identity-unresolved.jsonl rather than dropped.
